name: Stalker of the Woods
creator: kaizen
description:
**Features:**

- Custom models and textures

- Custom animations

- Support for all quality settings

- Custom VFX

- Custom SFX

- Custom Voice-over for all languages

- Custom loading screen and in-game icons

- A reanimated Daisy

- Edgy one liners



*"My favourite colour is red"*


Ever thought Ivern is too jolly of a character in all of his skins, even Old God? Well, Ivern Grandmaster and streamer IvernGott certainly did, because he commissioned me to make a much darker version of our beloved tree hugger. As such, I present you: Stalker of the Woods Ivern


Features a custom model for Ivern, put together with existing League assets, a new model for Daisy, a full suite of new animations that would better suit the forest horror that Ivern has become (excluding the emotes), new vfx, more fitting sfx and a full voice-over, showing just how much of a twisted shadow of himself Ivern has become.

Also, I included a few chromas. Use only one version at a time!
